description: Structural schema of the .kimo file format 0.1.0 (Draft). Semantic rules (referential integrity, override paths, variable types, …) are checked by validate() in @kimo/core-schema; see docs/spec/kimo-format-v0.1.md. Known features: layout/wrap, layout/stretch-baseline, size/min-max, text/runs, tokens/composite, fill/mesh, fill/shader, node/script, node/browser.

$schema.description: For format 0.1: "https://kimo.design/schema/kimo-0.1.json". Another version's URL is only a SCHEMA_URL_MISMATCH warning in validate().

components.description: Optional index of component node ids.
